title: Engagement Escape Aborts Active Session
description: When Escape is pressed while window engagement is active, abort the engagement (cancel interaction, clear command, dismiss chrome) via onAbort wired from CAD/puzzle play through ui Window capture.
summary:
Escape aborts active window engagement via EngagementInput.onAbort.

- ui/react: onAbort on EngagementInput; routeWindowEngagementEscape on Window capture; Engagement Escape calls onAbort (closes possibles list first).
- cad: buildInteractionReplEngagement wires onAbort to handleEscapeKey; global Escape also runs when focus is on engagement input; cad play engagementAbort bus command.
- puzzle/playground: engagementAbort command; puzzle clears cmd line and exits brush on abort.

Tests: @semio-tech/ui-react 101 passed.
